name: IMO Prelim Past Paper
statement:
Let $x = \sqrt{1 + \dfrac{1}{1^2} + \dfrac{1}{2^2}} + \sqrt{1 + \dfrac{1}{2^2} + \dfrac{1}{3^2}} + \cdots + \sqrt{1 + \dfrac{1}{2012^2} + \dfrac{1}{2013^2}}$. Find the value of $x - [x]$, where $[x]$ denotes the greatest integer not exceeding $x$.
Note that the answer is a fraction $\dfrac{a}{b}$, write your answer as $a+b$.
